captions.detailed: This 3D model features a dark grey, welded-steel four-post tower frame built on a square baseplate. The tower posts are cylindrical tubes reinforced with diagonal X-bracing on all four sides, with small triangular gusset plates securing the bases. At the top, a horizontal box-section crossbeam spans the frame to support a bronze-colored bell. The bell hangs from a cast-iron yoke connected to a cylindrical through-bolt pivot, allowing the bell to swing back and forth.
captions.instruction: Generate a 3D model of a four-post steel frame tower on a square baseplate. The tower should feature round-tube uprights, diagonal X-bracing, and a horizontal crossbeam at the top. Hang a bronze-colored bell from a yoke attached to a central pivot on the crossbeam, ensuring the bell is capable of pivoting.
captions.factory: The base is created using a flat box primitive. Four vertical cylinders are generated for the corner posts, and diagonal braces are constructed using rotated cylinders or boxes aligned to form X-patterns on each side. Small triangular extrusions are placed at the bottom of the posts to serve as gusset plates. A horizontal box-section crossbeam is placed at the top of the frame. The yoke assembly is built using a combination of boxes and cylinders, and the bell is modeled by revolving a custom profile or lofting concentric circles. The bell and yoke are attached to the crossbeam with a revolute joint representing the pivot shaft.
